description: Fictional-knowledge domains for the LLM-knowledge QA generator (llm_qa.py). One domain per task. An LLM invents non-existent but natural-sounding facts in each domain (real words, novel specifics), phrased as self-contained question/answer pairs. Each question is anchored on a globally unique invented entity, so every question maps to exactly one answer across all tasks with no task label at test time.
